claims.claim: Nikon z fc is a retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel APS-C sensor.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Nikon camera body and attached lens, but the exact model (Z fc) and sensor megapixel details are not readable; no model number/EXIF/label is shown.
Witness report identifies the brand as Nikon from photos 0–2; no Canon branding is reported as visible.

risks.risk: Exact camera model is not readable (could be a different Nikon body), which changes value and compatibility of accessories.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number on the camera body (e.g., Z fc / Z50 / D-series) and the lens model/part number ring.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown Nikon mirrorless/DSLR body with attached lens, worst-case for value (no model certainty).

risks.risk: Lens model/condition is unknown; lens clarity (haze/fungus/oil) and whether autofocus works affect price heavily.
risks.proof: A sharp photo of the lens front element and the lens markings (model/part number), plus a short video showing autofocus lock on a high-contrast subject.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used kit lens with potential optical issues (worst-case).

risks.risk: Functional status is unknown (shutter count, autofocus accuracy, metering, flash).
risks.proof: A clip showing the camera powering on, focusing, taking a photo, and reviewing the image on-screen (including flash test if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty until proven.

risks.risk: Sensor condition is unknown (dust, fungus, scratches) which can require cleaning/repair.
risks.proof: A photo of the sensor at maximum aperture (or a test shot of a blank wall/sky at high f-stop) showing dust/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing sensor cleaning (worst-case).

risks.risk: Battery health and completeness are unknown; only a battery pack is shown, but capacity/door/contacts not verified.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the battery label/capacity and a clip showing the battery charging/holding power (battery icon/percentage changes).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming battery may be weak and/or not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Memory card details are unknown (capacity and whether it’s included/working).
risks.proof: A photo showing the memory card brand/capacity label and a clip confirming the camera can read/write (recording a short video/photo).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming card may be low capacity or unverified.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness is unknown (charger, cables, strap, original box/manual not shown).
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of everything included, including charger model and any cables/strap/box/manual.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body+lens only with minimal caps (worst-case for missing accessories).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the exact camera model name/number on the body (and serial number label if available).
Send a clear close-up of the lens model/part number markings (and front element condition).
Provide a short video: power on → autofocus on a subject → take a photo → playback on screen.
Provide a sensor test shot (blank wall/sky at high f-stop) or a sensor close-up to check dust/fungus/scratches.
Show battery label/capacity and a clip confirming the battery charges and powers the camera reliably.
Show the memory card brand/capacity label and confirm the camera can record and play back files.
List and photograph all included accessories (charger, cables, strap, box/manual) in one full layout.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a Nikon camera body with an attached lens, but the exact model and key condition/function details needed to price confidently are not readable or shown. The seller’s claim conflicts on brand (Canon vs Nikon), so proof is required before setting a reliable price.
